name: Pledged Asset
description: One physical asset per loan (single-asset repossession model, secured-lending-brief.md) - deliberately NOT a portfolio/multi-asset structure like upstream Frappe Lending's Loan Security/Loan Security Assignment. No LTV/mark-to-market: declared_value is captured once at origination and never revalued. Status history is via Frappe's built-in track_changes + explicit add_comment() calls at each transition (same pattern asset_realisation.py already used), not a bespoke log child table - the existing mechanism already gives a real audit trail for free.

fields.label: Loan Application
fields.description: Traceability back to where the collateral description was originally captured (application time, not disbursement time - matches the real frontend flow in application/new/page.tsx).

fields.label: Status
fields.description: System-maintained. Pledged -> Repossession Triggered happens automatically when the loan becomes NPA (Process Loan Classification) - a signal only, not an action. Repossession Triggered -> Repossessed only happens when a human actually executes realise_pawn_asset() - never automatic. Pledged -> Released only happens when the loan is confirmed fully paid off via release_security().

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Free-text collateral description, matching Loan Application.description exactly (copied at disbursement time).

fields.label: Category
fields.description: Free text - no fixed category list exists in evidence, not inventing one.

fields.label: Declared Value at Origination
fields.description: One-time value declared at loan origination. NOT revalued/mark-to-market - no evidence Polaris's model needs ongoing appraisal (secured-lending-brief.md's explicit 'what NOT to do'). Not currently populated by the live application form (application/new/page.tsx only captures a free-text description) - a real gap, flagged in the delivery report, not silently assumed away.

fields.label: Loan Write Off
fields.description: Set when this asset is repossessed - links to the Loan Write Off that realise_pawn_asset() creates as the actual financial settlement.
